choices.reason: The abstract emphasizes high exposure without choosing disclosed or undisclosed, and both high-exposure originality estimates use the same main model. No later rule resolves that tie: both arms supply preset examples without chatbot interaction, and neither the paper nor the supplied records provide a distinguishing participant-level standardizer, session or sample priority, or contrast combining all AI arms against control.

choices.quote: We find that high AI exposure (but not low AI exposure) did not affect the creativity of individual ideas but did increase the average amount and rate of change of collective idea diversity.

choices.reason: Median pairwise distance is the main metric, but both global diversity and diversity evolution are emphasized, with no preferred disclosure arm. The remaining rules do not yield a unique candidate: participant-level standardizing statistics are unavailable, chain evolution is not repeated participant sessions, and no arm offers freer chatbot use, a contrast combining all AI arms, or a broader sample.
